login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to ${companyName} to continue to ${clientName}.
login.user-blocked: This account has been blocked. Contact the application's support.
login.password-change-required: This account's password must be reset before you can sign in. Choose "Forgot password?" below to set a new one.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.description: Sign up for ${companyName} to continue to ${clientName}.
signup.email-in-use: An account with this email or username already exists.
signup.invalid-username: Username must be 1-64 characters: letters, digits, and _ . + -.

logout.title: Log out?
logout.description: An application asked to end your session. Do you want to log out?

reset-password-request.title: Forgot your password?
reset-password-request.descriptionEmail: Enter the email address of your ${companyName} account and we will send you a link to reset your password.

reset-password-email.title: Check your email
reset-password-email.emailDescription: If an account exists for that address, we have sent a link to reset its password. The link expires in 24 hours.

reset-password.title: Choose a new password
reset-password.description: Enter a new password for your ${companyName} account.

reset-password-success.description: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in with your new password.

reset-password-error.descriptionExpired: To reset your password, return to the login page and select "Forgot Your Password" to send a new email.
reset-password-error.descriptionUsed: This link has already been used. To reset your password, return to the login page and select "Forgot Your Password" to send a new email.
reset-password-error.descriptionGeneric: To reset your password, return to the login page and select "Forgot Your Password" to send a new email.

email-verification-result.verifiedDescription: Your email address was successfully verified.
email-verification-result.errorDescription: Your email address could not be verified.

device-code-activation.title: Connect a device
device-code-activation.description: Type the code your device is showing.
device-code-activation.invalid-expired-code: That code is not valid or has expired. Check the code on your device and try again.

device-code-confirmation.title: Is this your device?
device-code-confirmation.description: Check that this code matches the one on your device.
device-code-confirmation.confirmationText: Confirm only if you started this on a device you own. ${clientName} will then be able to sign you in.

device-code-activation-allowed.description: You can go back to your device now.

device-code-activation-denied.description: Your device was not given access to your account. You can close this window.

consent.externalApp: ${clientName} is not operated by ${companyName}. If you allow it, you will be sent to ${callbackDomain}.
consent.externalDeviceApp: ${clientName} is not operated by ${companyName}. Allow it only if you trust it.
consent.confirmDescription: Continue only if you started this sign-in. You will be sent to ${callbackDomain}.

common.too-many-attempts: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

signup.password-too-short: Password must be at least ${min} characters.
signup.password-character-classes: Password must contain at least ${count} of: lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, symbols.
signup.password-identical-characters: Password must not contain three or more identical characters in a row.
signup.password-sequential-characters: Password must not contain three or more sequential characters, such as abc or 321.
signup.password-personal-info: Password must not contain personal information.
signup.username-too-short: Username must be at least ${min} characters.
signup.username-too-long: Username must be at most ${max} characters.

email-reset-password.subject: Reset your ${companyName} password
email-reset-password.heading: Reset your password
email-reset-password.body: We received a request to reset the password for your ${companyName} account. The link below works once and expires in 24 hours. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.

email-verify-email.subject: Verify your ${companyName} email address
email-verify-email.heading: Verify your email address
email-verify-email.body: Please confirm that this is the email address of your ${companyName} account. The link below works once and expires in 5 days. If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

email-import-done.subject: User import ${job} on ${tenant} has finished
email-import-done.subject-failed: User import ${job} on ${tenant} did not finish
email-import-done.heading: The user import has finished
email-import-done.heading-failed: The user import did not finish
email-import-done.body: The import ${job} into the connection ${connection} of the tenant ${tenant} has processed every record of its file.
email-import-done.body-failed: The import ${job} into the connection ${connection} of the tenant ${tenant} stopped before it processed its file. Records committed before it stopped are kept.
email-import-done.counts: New users: ${inserted}. Updated users: ${updated}. Records with errors: ${failed}. Records in total: ${total}.
email-import-done.footer: The job and its record errors stay available in the console and the Management API for 24 hours. You receive this email because you are an operator of this tenant.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: Return to the application and try again.
error.session-expired: Your login session has expired or is invalid. Return to the application and start again.
error.no-connection: No login method is enabled for this application.
error.signup-disabled: Sign-up is not available for this application.
error.server-error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
error.invalid-request: The application sent a request that could not be completed.
error.access-denied: The application was not given access to your account.
error.logout-unknown-client: The application that asked to log you out is not registered. You are still logged in.
error.logout-url-not-allowed: The address to return to after logout is not allowed for this application. You are still logged in.
error.logout-invalid: The logout request was not valid. You are still logged in.

reset.not-changed: Your password could not be changed. Try again or contact support.
